title: tckstats
description:
Calculate statistics on streamlines lengths.



References:

output.description: output only the field specified. Multiple such options can be supplied if required. Choices are: mean, median, std, min, max, count. Useful for use in scripts.
output.title: output

histogram.description: output a histogram of streamline lengths
histogram.title: histogram

dump.description: dump the streamlines lengths to a text file
dump.title: dump

ignorezero.description: do not generate a warning if the track file contains streamlines with zero length
ignorezero.title: ignorezero

tck_weights_in.description: specify a text scalar file containing the streamline weights
tck_weights_in.title: tck_weights_in

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
nthreads.title: nthreads

key.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
key.title: key

value.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
value.title: value

config.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
config.title: config

help.description: display this information page and exit.
help.title: help
